_doc: ONE meaning of 'promoted' (RULINGS CB1, CG2): promoted = an entry MASTER_DIRECTIVE.md.pre-ceo exists in the lexical sense (a regular file, a dangling symlink, a directory or an unreadable file all count — the protecting direction) OR the live MASTER_DIRECTIVE.md holds the generator's separator (scripts/gen_ceo_template.py SEPARATOR, LF or CRLF). The content decides; the backup only widens what the overwrite guards protect. Each reader builds REAL entries from these rows: cysjavis-pack/bin/tests/test_ceo_composition.py (javis_preflight, javis_org, cys-dept), src/pack.rs (cys::pack::ceo_promoted_in — update guard 4, which A12 in src/bin/cys.rs calls alone) and src-tauri/src/main.rs (the drift gate). md = null: the file does not exist. pre_ceo: null | file | dangling-link | directory | unreadable (link and unreadable rows are POSIX-only).
